newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria's Bulbank to join EBRD bank scheme.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria's Bulbank to join EBRD bank scheme.

text.p: Bulgaria's Bulbank will take part in a European Bank for Reconstruction and Development project for recapitalisation of United Bulgarian Bank (UBB) with an investment of $15.75 million against a 35 percent stake, Bulbank's chief executive director said.
"Bulbank will acquire a 35 percent stake from UBB against an investment of $15.75 million, which equals the one committed by the EBRD," Chavdar Kanchev told a news conference.
The EBRD is expected to acquire 35 percent of UBB against the same $15.75 million investment.
On the basis of equal investment with the EBRD, Bulbank will seek an equal role in UBB management and in all decisions on its future development, Kanchev said.

Last December, UBB raised its capital to 21.07 billion levs from 679.5 million levs through a new share issue which was covered mainly by the Bank Consolidation Company (BCC) through domestic bad loan bonds worth $119 million.
A recent capital increase boosted the stake of BCC, which manages state equity in local banks, to some 98 percent from 89 percent.
The EBRD and Bulbank are expected to invest in a new capital increase.
The UBB was set up through a merger of 22 smaller financial institutions four years ago as a first consolidation project implemented by the BCC.
